C1417.title: Deus Finance Oracle Manipulation Attack Causes Over $3 Million Loss
C1417.summary: Deus Finance suffered an oracle manipulation attack where the attacker manipulated oracle data through large transactions, leading to a series of erroneous liquidations in the protocol. The attacker subsequently exploited price discrepancies to conduct arbitrage trades, profiting over $3 million.
